## [#10939: fix: preserve locale-specific Arabic number separators](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10939)

- **Change:** low complexity under the localized, fewer-than-50-source-lines, single-package criterion: seven added and five removed source lines plus 75 test lines in `@internationalized/number`. The parser now preserves punctuation that is already the locale's native group or decimal symbol instead of overwriting it with Arabic keyboard alternatives.
- **Readiness concern:** the [PR description](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10939) says the "understanding checklist remains unchecked pending that review." This is explicit unfinished author review, not an inference from AI use or an unchecked box alone. [CONTRIBUTING.md lines 68-79](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/CONTRIBUTING.md#L68-L79) requires the human author to own every line, decision and explanation.
- **Issue / direction:** [#10936](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10936) reports formatter/parser round trips producing `12345`, `1250`, `25` and `NaN` instead of fractional values in Sindhi, Punjabi and Urdu Arabic numbering. Main's [NumberParser.ts lines 256-265](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/%40internationalized/number/src/NumberParser.ts#L256-L265) unconditionally replaces comma with the decimal symbol and period with the group symbol; the [patch at lines 256-267](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/d2e856b494b85611f7c126273f36b654a9dc50da/packages/%40internationalized/number/src/NumberParser.ts#L256-L267) guards both conflicts, plausibly fixing the exact reproduction. All three issue comments were read. The reporter [answered snowystinger's request to recheck main and closed issues](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10936#issuecomment-6711674701), citing current main including #10876; no contrary maintainer direction was found.
- **Tests / compatibility:** [NumberParser.test.js lines 35-86](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/d2e856b494b85611f7c126273f36b654a9dc50da/packages/%40internationalized/number/test/NumberParser.test.js#L35-L86) uses the real formatter and public parser APIs for the reported round trips, negative values, grouping, currency, percent, units and keyboard punctuation; [lines 666-688](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/d2e856b494b85611f7c126273f36b654a9dc50da/packages/%40internationalized/number/test/NumberParser.test.js#L666-L688) covers incomplete fractions and repeated decimal rejection. These are meaningful end-to-end tests for the standalone API reproduction, not private-state assertions; no new rendered NumberField interaction test is included. The author reports red/green parser results and existing NumberField coverage, but these claims were not independently executed. Locale support and default `sd` Arabic numbering are asserted, making ICU/CLDR variation worth reviewing. The description reports five unrelated local DatePicker/DateRangePicker failures that also occur with upstream parser code; all returned PR checks, including CLA, test variants, browser tests, SSR, lint and type comparison, succeed. No attribution of those local failures to this patch is established.
- **API / existing solution:** no new or removed public prop, export, type or event, changed default, DOM/class/data-attribute/CSS-variable change is present. Existing `parse` and partial-input behavior changes for affected punctuation, prioritizing native grouping over a comma-as-decimal fallback where they conflict. This is a corrective behavior change, not a new API; no `needs API review` proposal on current evidence. Main's [NumberParser docs lines 32-44](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/blob/82959b6a9ac4ea717228636b99fc8fd24736a7f4/packages/%40internationalized/number/docs/NumberParser.mdx#L32-L44) already promise locale-aware parsing and accept format options but provide no switch that preserves these same Arabic digits and native separators without the faulty sanitizer. Changing to Latin numbering would change the required representation, not solve the reported round trip. No equivalent existing solution or evidence of previously working behavior was established, so no `has workaround`, `needs decision` or `regression` proposal.
- **Duplicates / red flags:** searches covered #10936, Sindhi, Arabic number/separator behavior, NumberParser and recent `NumberParser.ts` mentions. No supported competing PR was found. Merged [#10876](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10876), with signed CLA, fixes [#10875](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/issues/10875)'s separator-only numbering-system selection; its diff changes `getNumberingSystem`, not these native-symbol replacements. Keep that fix and consider this separately, with no closure or duplicate notice. It touches no workflow, manifest/dependency, lockfile, install script or build configuration requiring the mandatory **needs security review** flag. Verification throughout was by reading only.
